description: This file defines utility structs and functions for managing Android Binder process and thread states, including starting/joining thread pools and retrieving caller information such as UID, PID, and security context.

classes.name: ProcessState
classes.description: Utility class for managing Binder process state, including thread pool control.

classes.name: ThreadState
classes.description: Utility class for managing and querying Binder thread state and caller identity.

methods.name: start_thread_pool
methods.description: Starts the Binder IPC thread pool.

methods.name: set_thread_pool_max_thread_count
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of threads in the Binder thread pool.

methods.name: join_thread_pool
methods.description: Blocks until the Binder thread pool terminates.

methods.name: get_calling_uid
methods.description: Returns the UID of the caller in a binder transaction.

methods.name: get_calling_pid
methods.description: Returns the PID of the caller in a binder transaction.

methods.name: is_handling_transaction
methods.description: Checks if the current thread is handling a binder transaction.

methods.name: with_calling_sid
methods.description: Provides the caller's security context (SID) for permission checks.
